name: Cultist: Tentacle of C'Thun attacks only what its owner is fighting (#420, #8637)
contract: Tentacle of C'Thun 801153 (Spell.dbc, class 25 grant at level 4): 'Summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods near you for 30 sec. It will seek an enemy out, dealing ... Shadow Damage every 1.5 sec'. Effect 0 summons creature 50272 with SummonProperties 63, which SummonProperties.dbc gives Category 1 (ally), Type 4 (totem), Slot 1: the tentacle is an attacking totem whose pulse casts Mental Assault 801151 (PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, 1.5 sec, triggering 804999). The summon must not pull aggro on its own: with the owner out of combat it leaves an idle hostile creature (faction template 14, hostile to players) and a neutral creature (faction template 7, no reputation index, no hostile mask) untouched for four 1.5 sec pulses. Once the owner attacks the hostile creature, the tentacle joins on that target (801151 lands) while the neutral bystander stays untouched.

steps.label: SETUP: the owner is not engaged with anything
SETUP: the Tentacle of C'Thun is summoned
Four tentacle pulses with the owner out of combat
DISCRIMINATING: the tentacle leaves the idle hostile creature alone
The idle hostile creature took no damage

The tentacle joins the fight the owner started
The neutral creature is still untouched
The neutral creature took no damage at any point
